data.name: Seahorse Pools & Spas
data.address: 3100 Alta Mere Dr, Fort Worth, TX 76116

reviews.text: From start to finish we love our new pool. Seahorse was great to work with. Shannon showed us 3D renderings from our ideas and really helped us make decisions on the design and materials, which turned out beautiful! The work crews were very professional and the final product was a high quality custom pool for less than a fiberglass drop in and we were swimming in less than a month. We are loving it! Highly recommend Seahorse Pools!

Seahorse pools and Spas is the best ever.  We have used them for over 25 years and we’ve never had an issue. Darron just finished cleaning our filter and he did a wonderful job.  Very professional and knowledgeable about what he was doing.  George is the service manager and he is always there if we have questions or need service.  Hugo is our weekly pool person and we couldn’t ask for a better person. Definitely a FIVE STAR company.

Had Darron come out and clean my pool filter. Appreciate all he did to keep our pool operating at its peak performance. From the time he arrived to the time he left everything was clean, professional, and complete.  Thanks for the superior service!

An independent contractor recently came out on behalf of Seahorse Pools to work on our pool pump.  The pump is currently working great with plenty of discharge.  The contractor also spent significant time cleaning out the filter which I took as a sign of doing a quality job. I also appreciated the fact that the contractor, Darron, took the time to thoroughly clean up after his work was finished including returning the hose to its original location and condition.  Thank you for the attention to d

Have used this company for years. Never disappoints
. Had Dave and Datton out today to replace some parts in pump. Very thorough. Also had cover put on for winter
Also love working with George. Takes really good care of my service work.
Donald does regular cleaning. So courteous and does great work

Absolutely great to work with from start to finish! We've recommended Seahorse  Pools & Spas to anyone considering putting in a pool. Ken & Shannon gave great recommendations for finishes, dimensions, and layout. We even added a chiller after installation (and a hot Texas summer!), which Ken expertly installed. I highly recommend Seahorse Pools & Spas.

We have been using Seahorse Pools for over two years and have always received such great service. Darren stopped by for our filter cleaning recently and did a fantastic job; and Donald stays on top of the weekly service like a pro. Both are so friendly and a pleasure to chat with!

Darron did a fantastic job getting my equipment set up for winter.  The Seahorse Team always takes care of service and equipment quickly and professionally.

You guys are really appreciated

David, Seahorse Pool service tech arrived to my service call request and it was all good from start to finish. David returned the freeze guard monitor  from not-operational to operational in record time. I was very satisfied with Seahorse Pools and David their highly experienced pool technician.  Richard Frazer

We have used Seahorse Pools off and on for 30 years.  They always come to my rescue!  This time George worked us into the schedule the next day.  Dave was our technician.  He was great!  Punctual, courteous and fixed the problem in no time.  Thank you again Seahorse Pools for a great job!
DARRON Cleaning does an amazing job! He was polite and professional. We also have weekly service by Hugo, and he always keeps our pool sparkling clean and ready to use. Highly recommend!

Been a customer for over 20 years. Great team and always provides great service. Darron took care of cleaning the filters today and did a wonderful job. They have a weekly cleaning service that is reasonable and takes care of chemicals and cleaning.

Seahorse designed and built our pool 12 years ago. It has been wonderful.

Today Darren cleaned our filters and worked with great skill and in a professional way.

Thanks

Susan

Seahorse pools and especially Dave are the real pool wizards of Fort Worth.  Was able to take an old green algae infested pool and with monthly service a pool wizardry make it blue and wonderful relaxing oasis without breaking the bank.

Booster pump broke. George came out that Friday afternoon and confirmed we needed a new one. Broken one was under warranty so we were set to get a new one Monday. David came out and went to work installing the new pump. Next he checked our filters and they were in need of cleaning. We had David  clean the 4 filters. He was nice and personable. Thanks Seahorse for great service after the sale/install!
Seahorse has been serving our family for years. Very courteous, helpful, and professional. I’m new to pool ownership. Darron was able to answer all of my questions when performing filter maintenance.
David did a great job with my equipment upgrade I am back up and running after being dead for four days. Upgraded to the new iaqualink RS control system with a completely sealed box.
Darron gave us 5 star service today! He’s was on time and very professional and knowledgeable! We love Seahorse Pools!
We had a great experience with Seahorse pools and spas! David was knowledgeable and efficient getting our pool up and running again. Will definitely recommend and use again!

Six years ago Seahorse Pools designed and built our pool and spa.  They were able to transform our thoughts into something that was unique and beautiful. They offered many useful suggestions that we never would have thought of on our own.  They have maintained and serviced it in a professional manner.
